# Optileno

> The honest planner for freelancers. Optileno checks a new client request against your real working week and tells you whether it fits, which existing projects would slip, and the earliest date you can safely promise — with a reply ready to send.

- Who it's for: freelancers (designers, developers, video editors, writers, consultants) juggling several client projects at once.
- How it works: you set your real focused hours per weekday, add projects with remaining hours and deadlines ("Acme — landing page, 12h, Friday"), and Optileno schedules them earliest-deadline-first to show risk, buffer and open capacity.
- Key feature: "Can I say yes?" — an instant verdict (yes / tight / not by then) on any new request, plus a counter-offer date.
- Privacy: local-first. No account; data stays in the user's browser.
- Price: free during early access.
- App: https://www.optileno.com/app
